notes.title: v1.0.6 Update Notes
notes.notes:
1. Main menu: Added simple level selection when starting new game.
2. Collectibles are not reset on new game anymore.
3. The door that require holding switch in the first laser room area now permanently opens after solving the laser puzzle.
4. Slight changes in several dialogues.
5. Slight changes in the laser reflector mechanics.

notes.title: v1.0.5 Update Notes
notes.notes:
1. Added new options in pause menu:
    1.1 Restart from last checkpoint - Load auto-saved file.
    1.2 Quick save - Manually save the game.
    1.3 Quick load - Load quick-saved file.

2. Changed some tables' collider. Player can now crawl beneath these tables.

3. Several bug-fixes: 
- Character no longer stuck while holding the corner of the movable laser terminals.
- Character no longer stuck on chairs.
- Movable objects can no longer be pushed/pulled diagonally from the corner.
